request: GPT CHAT #40 identify actual Docker runtime mounted source for receiver/writer and investigate 16000/1000 result truncation (no secrets)

bounded_host_request.command:
set -e
echo CONTAINER_IMAGE_ID_BEGIN
docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' server-core-bounded-host | sha256sum | cut -c1-20
echo CONTAINER_IMAGE_ID_END
echo CONTAINER_MOUNTS_BEGIN
docker inspect --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}}={{.Type}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}' server-core-bounded-host | grep -E 'server-core|gace|/app|/run|/home' || true
echo CONTAINER_MOUNTS_END
echo RUNTIME_SCRIPT_LOCATIONS_BEGIN
docker exec server-core-bounded-host sh -c 'find /app /opt /srv /home -maxdepth 5 \( -name servercore_service_deploy_socket.py -o -name servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py \) -print 2>/dev/null' || true
echo RUNTIME_SCRIPT_LOCATIONS_END
